long_biography.plain_text:
At 12, Hüseyin Rüştü Altunbaş began the commercial life that eventually linked construction, tourism and maritime enterprise. After naval service, he entered construction in 1952, founded an import-export firm for machinery and later established Hisar Turistik Tesisleri on the Bosphorus. Altunbaş Turizm subsequently brought construction, travel services, insurance and maritime tourism together under one company.

His interest in boats developed into a family production programme rather than a leisure sideline. Altunbaş said he had completed five large vessels, selling earlier vessels before collaborating with his sons Volkan and Erkan on Egeria. Built at Bandırma, the project reflected his preference for financing developments from the family's own resources and directing their design in-house.
